title: The Origin of Achiote (Mu)
description: After a smallpox epidemic, the Tsáchila elders received the sign to paint themselves with achiote to trick death and protect themselves.

title: Etsa and the Blowgun
description: The Shuar myth about the balance between hunting and the repopulation of the jungle.

title: The Kuillur (The Star)
description: Kichwa stories about how the stars came down to earth.

title: The Tapada Lady
description: An elegant woman who appears in Guayaquil, attracts men with her perfume and then shows a skull face.
